matter_background.original: Lot 3 of the land called Mahatenna in extent of 30 perches in Plan No. 251 dated 5/7/1999 made by A.Samaranayaka Liscensed Surveyor is registered in the Homagama Land Registry under Vol/Folio A 350/25. The owner, sub divided Lot 3 into 2 lots namely Lots 34 and 3B as depicted in Plan No.255 dated 8/12/2000 made by the same Surveyor. He sold Lot 3A to Dininda Perera by Deed No.351 attested by Gamini Herath, Notary Public. Lot 3A was sold at a price of Rupees 7 million but the Commissioner of Revenue of the Western Provincial Council in his opinion of valuation for stamp duty, values the property at Rupees 7.5 million. Dininda Perera constructed a house on Lot 3A and Leased it out to Nimal Fernando for 2 years on a monthly rental of Rs. 75,000/-, He obtained 1 years rent as an advance to set off against 2nd years rent. When the Lease Agreement was submitted for registration the Land Registry informed that it could not be registered because the sub division of Lot 3A is wrongfully registered in the same folio as the original land (Lot 3) is registered namely in Vol/Folio A 350/25.
